methods.name: Exact rational-affine BRC Newton schedule-validity strata
capabilities: represent exact rational affine parameter forms and Newton polynomials
compute affine Taylor forms and exact contact order at rational parameter points
compute the exact selected rational-valuation Newton scale on a parameter point
construct the fixed-scale affine edge polynomial
construct exact affine equality/non-equality constraints for a declared rational root multiplicity
propagate affine coefficient dependence through a declared scheduled Newton substitution
evaluate affine Newton layers and residual states at rational parameter points
typed_inputs: rational-affine polynomial coefficients over a fixed finite parameter list
declared rational roots and positive multiplicities
declared or point-selected RationalValuationScale Newton factors
typed_outputs: exact contact orders and selected scale at a parameter point
evaluated rational Newton layers and states
methods.hard_boundary: Declared rational-root schedule validity is not global root-selector stability. The promoted constructibility result assumes rational-affine coefficient dependence and a finite declared schedule; this tool is not a generic CAD/decomposition engine, complete Puiseux solver, or multi-generator algebraic-field package.
